fast.$description: Fast transitions for micro-interactions, icons, and state toggles (100ms)

moderate.$description: Standard transitions for dropdowns, tooltips, and small surfaces (200ms)

slow.$description: Deliberate movement for expand/collapse, drawers, and sheets (350ms)

deliberate.$description: Complex choreographies, full-screen dialogs, and page transitions (500ms)

standard.$description: Standard ease for elements moving within the screen

enter.$description: Deceleration curve for elements entering the screen

exit.$description: Acceleration curve for elements exiting the screen
